outcome: Impact of nutrition and environment on microbiota
cohort: 250 healthy pregnant women and their infants
finding: This study aims to characterize the trajectory of infant intestinal microbiota development during the first two years of life and its association with maternal factors, nutrition, environment, and health outcomes.
mod_finding: The study will investigate the impact of mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean) on maternal microbiome transfer and subsequent infant microbiota development.
